intended_distribution: Bundled with LocalPinyinIME source and unsigned development packages as the project-maintained local_core dictionary layer.
source_policy: Project-maintained local_core includes independently authored vocabulary and reference-derived words/name/title lists contributed in batches 012 through 015. Those batches are attributed separately with immutable contribution commits and the known source sites; exact page/revision manifests were not supplied. Their source-site content and trademarks are not relicensed by the project's MIT code license. Project-generated pinyin and relative ranking weights are editorial data, not scraped internet/search/corpus frequencies. No third-party bulk Rime, Sogou, Baidu, Microsoft, Google, or public GitHub candidate dictionary was imported into local_core. The separate standard_zh_pinyin.tsv layer contains licensed Rime/AOSP vocabulary recorded in sources/lexicon_sources.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Pypinyin is an authoring-only pronunciation checker and is not bundled. The earlier pronunciation_review dated 2026-10-12 does not claim formal linguistic review of the remote 2026-10-14 batches.
frequency_policy: Frequency values are project-maintained relative ranking weights using coarse bands such as 9000, 7000, 6000, 5500, 5000, and 3000. They are not internet frequency, search frequency, commercial IME frequency, or external corpus statistics.
review_status: approved for development technical integrity: first-party batches reviewed individually; user-requested upstream name/title indexes audited with incomplete exact source-page manifests and non-exhaustive linguistic review. This technical approval is not a blanket source-content license or commercial-use grant.

pronunciation_review.method: All project entries checked against all per-character readings; flagged rows reviewed manually; accepted input aliases retained
pronunciation_review.note: Also corrected 简朴/调班/调课/调色/调色盘/有线耳机 by compound review. This is not a claim of exhaustive linguistic correctness.
